summary: Iteration 909 — Frontend-only verification of the Travel Visa CountryFlag/responsive-onboarding fixes. VERIFIED: (a) TravelVisaOnboarding renders REAL flag images (flagcdn.com/w80/.png) for every country card — NOT letter codes/emoji fallback; 33 flagcdn tags loaded at 1920x1080, 768x1024, and 390x844. (b) Cards use a centered maxWidth=960 container, 2-column grid at desktop (1920px) and tablet (768px), collapsing to 1-column at mobile (390px) — verified in screenshots. (c) 3-step onboarding flow works end-to-end: country → visa type → experience level → Get Started; Back button restores previous step (verified round-trip step2→step1→step2 in DOM). (d) Post-onboarding TravelVisaMain dashboard renders 25 flagcdn tags — Top Countries cards (Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Poland ...) and Trending Destinations pills (US, Canada, UK, Germany, France, Australia, Japan, UAE, Singapore) all display real color flag images (verified in screenshot iter909_main_dashboard.png). (e) 30+ tv-v2-* main-dashboard testids present (tv-v2-tab-explore/progress/certificates/media/coach/interview/quiz/challenge/embassy/leaderboard/notifications + tv-v2-kpi-countries/categories/readiness/plan) — regression clean. (f) Home '/' redirects to /welcome unauthenticated then to '/' after login normally (no blank screens). Static export serving correctly. Onboarding step 1 flag testids emit as country-flag-us/ca/gb/de/au/fr/jp/ae (from shared CountryFlag component).

ui_bugs.issue: In the 1920x1080 desktop screenshot after advancing to step 3, the level cards (Beginner/Intermediate/Expert) were not visible in the visible viewport area even though DOM elements were present (tv-v2-onboarding-level-beginner testid found and clickable, and clicking Get Started successfully completed onboarding). The visible content area appeared blank between the header progress bar and the footer Back/Get Started buttons. May be a ScrollView layout quirk or scroll-position reset issue after step transition — low priority since interaction still succeeds. Repro: log in → /features/travel-visa → click country US → Continue → click visa tourist → Continue → observe blank content area at 1920x1080 desktop.

integration_issues.flow: Free user post-onboarding main dashboard rendering
integration_issues.issue: For the free user (p1.free.1779113329@example.com), after completing the onboarding overlay the underlying TravelVisaMain page showed an entirely blank content area (only header + fixed-footer banners visible). Admin session after full onboarding completion DID render the Top Countries + Trending Destinations correctly. Suggests either (i) a subscription/plan gating issue rendering nothing when TravelVisaMain doesn't have entitlements, or (ii) a paywall banner in place of content. Worth confirming with a free user run once onboarding is properly persisted in a clean session.

design_issues.screen: Travel Visa onboarding (all steps, all viewports)
issues: Dark-mode was not testable this run — no obvious sidebar/header theme-toggle data-testid was found on the /features/travel-visa route while the onboarding overlay was blocking main sidebar. Recommend main agent expose a stable data-testid like sidebar-theme-toggle or theme-toggle at the app-shell level so QA can flip modes reliably.

action_items: Investigate the step-3 experience-level ScrollView rendering: at 1920x1080 the three level cards render off-screen / not visible even though they are in DOM and interactive; the underlying ScrollView `contentContainerStyle={[container, { padding: 20, paddingBottom: 40 }]}` combined with `flex: 1` may cause layout collapse when height computes to 0 in the RN-Web ScrollView on step transition. Consider a min-height on the ScrollView content container OR explicit `flexGrow: 1` on the child View.
Investigate free-user paywall/blank state on TravelVisaMain after onboarding overlay closes — either surface a paywall UI or render the KPI + tabs regardless of plan.
Add a stable app-shell theme toggle data-testid (e.g., `sidebar-theme-toggle` or `theme-toggle`) so dark-mode QA can be automated on any route.

OPTIONAL: Add a dedicated data-testid on the outer TravelVisaMain content root (e.g., `tv-v2-country-<iso>` for Top Countries cards and `tv-v2-trending-<iso>` for Trending pills) so future E2E can assert specific country flag rendering rather than count-only checks.
critical_code_review_comments: CountryFlag.tsx: emoji→ISO fallback logic is clean and the onError=setFailed handler correctly falls back to the emoji Text when flagcdn is unreachable. Consider preloading/caching common flag URLs (US/CA/GB/DE/AU/FR/JP/AE) to avoid 8+ parallel network fetches on onboarding open — minor perf.

TravelVisaOnboarding.tsx: `ScrollView style={{ flex: 1 }} contentContainerStyle={[container, { padding: 20, paddingBottom: 40 }]}` — the container object also carries `alignSelf: 'center'` which as a contentContainerStyle may behave differently across RN-Web engines and could contribute to the step-3 blank-render observation. Recommend moving `alignSelf` off the contentContainerStyle and instead wrapping children in an inner centered View, OR guarantee non-zero content height with `flexGrow: 1` / `minHeight: '60vh'` on web.

TravelVisaOnboarding: the onboarding root is rendered as an overlay (tv-v2-onboarding-overlay present alongside tv-v2-root) — this is fine but ensure the overlay unmounts (or receives aria-hidden) once onComplete fires so screen readers don't announce both surfaces. Not a blocker.

The country testids on onboarding are `tv-v2-onboarding-country-{iso}` (lowercase), continue button `tv-v2-onboarding-continue`, back `tv-v2-onboarding-back`, skip `tv-v2-onboarding-skip`. The CountryFlag component emits `country-flag-{iso}` testids on its . flagcdn.com/w80/.png is used, w80 = 80px width. Main dashboard tabs: tv-v2-tab-embassy, tv-v2-tab-interview (not `tv-tab-*`). Embassy country chips prefix `tv-embassy-country-` and interview sim chips prefix `tv-sim-country-` — these live inside the tab panels once tab is clicked. rca_of_the_issue: N/A for the main fix — the fix is working. The one visual quirk on step 3 (blank content area at 1920x1080) is a probable RN-Web ScrollView flex/alignSelf edge case, not a functional blocker. Interaction still works because DOM elements are present and clickable.
